dataset: Model-knowledge draft fill for missing standard points (GB)
policy: Every record is draft / model_draft_pending_source_review. Conservative textbook-level content written by Claude from standard TCM education knowledge. Must be verified against WHO SAPL, CloudTCM, and professional textbooks before any promotion. Needling fields are study reference only, not operating instructions.

records.location_zh: 面部，目外眥外側 0.5 寸凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the face, in the depression 0.5 cun lateral to the outer canthus of the eye.
functions_en: Calms the liver, extinguishes wind, brightens the eyes.
contraindications: 眼周穴位，避免刺入眶內深部。

records.location_zh: 面部，耳屏間切跡前方，下頜骨髁突後緣，張口呈凹陷處。
records.location_en: On the face, anterior to the intertragic notch, posterior to the condylar process of the mandible, in the depression formed when the mouth is open.
functions_en: Opens the portals, benefits the ears.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 頭部，顴弓上緣中央凹陷中（下關 ST7 直上）。
records.location_en: On the head, in the depression at the center of the superior border of the zygomatic arch, directly above ST7.
functions_en: Benefits the ears, relieves spasm, dispels wind.

records.location_zh: 頭部，頭維（ST8）至曲鬢（GB7）弧形連線的上 1/4 與下 3/4 交點處。
records.location_en: On the head, at the junction of the upper quarter and lower three-quarters of the curved line from ST8 to GB7.
functions_en: Clears heat, dispels wind, relieves pain.

records.location_zh: 頭部，頭維（ST8）至曲鬢（GB7）弧形連線的中點處。
records.location_en: On the head, at the midpoint of the curved line from ST8 to GB7.
functions_en: Clears heat, dispels wind, reduces swelling.

records.location_zh: 頭部，頭維（ST8）至曲鬢（GB7）弧形連線的上 3/4 與下 1/4 交點處。
records.location_en: On the head, at the junction of the upper three-quarters and lower quarter of the curved line from ST8 to GB7.
functions_en: Clears heat, releases the exterior, dispels wind.

records.location_zh: 頭部，耳前鬢角髮際後緣的垂線與耳尖水平線的交點處。
records.location_en: On the head, at the intersection of the vertical line along the posterior border of the temple hairline and the horizontal line through the ear apex.
functions_en: Clears heat, relieves pain, unblocks the channel.

records.location_zh: 頭部，耳尖直上，入髮際 1.5 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, directly above the ear apex, 1.5 cun within the hairline.
functions_en: Calms the liver, extinguishes wind, unblocks the channel.

records.location_zh: 頭部，耳根後緣直上，入髮際 2 寸（率谷後約 0.5 寸）。
records.location_en: On the head, directly above the posterior border of the auricular root, 2 cun within the hairline, about 0.5 cun posterior to GB8.
functions_en: Dispels wind, settles fright, clears heat.

records.location_zh: 頭部，耳後乳突的後上方，天衝（GB9）與完骨（GB12）弧形連線的上 1/3 與下 2/3 交點處。
records.location_en: On the head, posterosuperior to the mastoid process, at the junction of the upper third and lower two-thirds of the curved line from GB9 to GB12.
functions_en: Dispels wind, relieves pain, transforms phlegm.

records.location_zh: 頭部，耳後乳突的後上方，天衝（GB9）與完骨（GB12）弧形連線的上 2/3 與下 1/3 交點處。
records.location_en: On the head, posterosuperior to the mastoid process, at the junction of the upper two-thirds and lower third of the curved line from GB9 to GB12.
functions_en: Calms the liver, relieves pain, benefits the ears.

records.location_zh: 頭部，耳後乳突的後下方凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the head, in the depression posteroinferior to the mastoid process.
functions_en: Calms the liver, extinguishes wind, calms the spirit.

records.location_zh: 頭部，前髮際上 0.5 寸，神庭（GV24）旁開 3 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, 0.5 cun within the anterior hairline, 3 cun lateral to GV24.
functions_en: Calms the spirit, settles fright, clears heat.

records.location_zh: 頭部，瞳孔直上，眉上 1 寸。
records.location_en: On the forehead, directly above the pupil, 1 cun superior to the eyebrow.
functions_en: Clears the head, brightens the eyes, dispels wind.
records.needling: 平刺 0.3-0.5 寸（常向下透魚腰）。

records.location_zh: 頭部，瞳孔直上，入前髮際 0.5 寸（神庭與頭維連線的中點）。
records.location_en: On the head, directly above the pupil, 0.5 cun within the anterior hairline, midway between GV24 and ST8.
functions_en: Benefits the eyes and ears, calms the spirit.

records.location_zh: 頭部，瞳孔直上，前髮際上 1.5 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, directly above the pupil, 1.5 cun within the anterior hairline.
functions_en: Brightens the eyes, extinguishes wind.

records.location_zh: 頭部，瞳孔直上，前髮際上 2.5 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, directly above the pupil, 2.5 cun within the anterior hairline.
functions_en: Calms the liver, brightens the eyes, dispels wind.

records.location_zh: 頭部，瞳孔直上，前髮際上 4 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, directly above the pupil, 4 cun within the anterior hairline.
functions_en: Frees the portals, dispels wind, clears heat.

records.location_zh: 頭部，枕外隆凸上緣外側，風池（GB20）直上（與腦戶 GV17 相平）。
records.location_en: On the head, lateral to the superior border of the external occipital protuberance, directly above GB20, level with GV17.
functions_en: Arouses the brain, calms the spirit, dispels wind.

records.location_zh: 側胸部，舉臂，腋中線上，第 4 肋間隙中。
records.location_en: On the lateral chest, on the midaxillary line, in the 4th intercostal space, with the arm raised.
functions_en: Regulates qi, unbinds the chest, reduces swelling.
records.needling: 沿肋間斜刺或平刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 胸壁穴位，深刺有氣胸風險。
danger: Pneumothorax risk — oblique or transverse insertion along the intercostal space only.

records.location_zh: 側胸部，淵腋（GB22）前 1 寸，平乳頭，第 4 肋間隙中。
records.location_en: On the lateral chest, 1 cun anterior to GB22, level with the nipple, in the 4th intercostal space.
functions_en: Downbears counterflow, calms wheezing, regulates qi.
records.needling: 沿肋間斜刺或平刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 胸壁穴位，深刺有氣胸風險。
danger: Pneumothorax risk — no perpendicular deep insertion.

records.location_zh: 上腹部，乳頭直下，第 7 肋間隙中（前正中線旁開 4 寸）。
records.location_en: On the upper abdomen, directly below the nipple, in the 7th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.
functions_zh: 利膽疏肝，降逆和中。膽之募穴。
functions_en: Benefits the gallbladder, spreads liver qi, harmonizes the middle. Front-mu of the gallbladder.
records.needling: 沿肋間斜刺或平刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可深刺 — 深部為肝膽。
contraindications: 深部為肝膽與胸腔，不可深刺。
danger: Liver and gallbladder lie deep — oblique insertion only.

records.location_zh: 側腰部，第 12 肋游離端下際。
records.location_en: On the lateral abdomen, below the free end of the 12th rib.
functions_zh: 益腎利水，健脾溫陽。腎之募穴。
functions_en: Benefits the kidney, promotes water metabolism. Front-mu of the kidney.
records.needling: 斜刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可深刺 — 深部為腎臟。
danger: Kidney lies deep — no deep insertion.

records.location_zh: 側腹部，第 11 肋游離端直下，平臍處。
records.location_en: On the lateral abdomen, directly below the free end of the 11th rib, level with the umbilicus.
functions_en: Fortifies the spleen, drains damp, regulates menstruation and discharge.

records.location_zh: 下腹部，髂前上棘內側，平臍下 3 寸處。
records.location_en: On the lower abdomen, medial to the anterior superior iliac spine, level with 3 cun below the umbilicus.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation and discharge, orders the lower burner.

records.location_zh: 下腹部，髂前上棘的前下方 0.5 寸（五樞前下）。
records.location_en: On the lower abdomen, 0.5 cun anteroinferior to the anterior superior iliac spine.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation and discharge, promotes water metabolism.

records.location_zh: 髖區，髂前上棘與股骨大轉子最高點連線的中點處。
records.location_en: In the hip region, at the midpoint between the anterior superior iliac spine and the prominence of the greater trochanter.
functions_en: Relaxes the sinews, strengthens the lumbar region.
indications_en: Lower limb atrophy or painful obstruction

records.location_zh: 大腿外側部中線上，膕橫紋上 7 寸；直立垂手時，中指尖所指凹陷處。
records.location_en: On the midline of the lateral thigh, 7 cun proximal to the popliteal crease, where the tip of the middle finger rests when standing with arms at the sides.
functions_en: Dispels wind-damp, unblocks the channel.
indications_en: Lower limb atrophy or painful obstruction

records.location_zh: 大腿外側，膕橫紋上 5 寸（風市下 2 寸），髂脛束後緣。
records.location_en: On the lateral thigh, 5 cun proximal to the popliteal crease, 2 cun distal to GB31, posterior to the iliotibial band.
functions_en: Unblocks the channel, dispels wind-cold.
indications_en: Lower limb atrophy or painful obstruction

records.location_zh: 膝外側，股骨外上髁後上緣，股二頭肌腱與髂脛束之間凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the lateral knee, in the depression between the biceps femoris tendon and the iliotibial band, posterosuperior to the lateral epicondyle of the femur.
functions_en: Relaxes the sinews, benefits the joint.

records.location_zh: 小腿外側，外踝尖上 7 寸，腓骨後緣。
records.location_en: On the lateral lower leg, 7 cun proximal to the tip of the lateral malleolus, on the posterior border of the fibula.
functions_zh: 寧神定志，舒筋活絡。陽維脈郄穴。
functions_en: Calms the spirit, relaxes the sinews. Xi-cleft of the Yang Linking Vessel.

records.location_zh: 小腿外側，外踝尖上 7 寸，腓骨前緣。
records.location_en: On the lateral lower leg, 7 cun proximal to the tip of the lateral malleolus, on the anterior border of the fibula.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，通絡安神。郄穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, unblocks the channel. Xi-cleft point.

records.location_zh: 小腿外側，外踝尖上 5 寸，腓骨前緣。
records.location_en: On the lateral lower leg, 5 cun proximal to the tip of the lateral malleolus, on the anterior border of the fibula.
functions_zh: 疏肝明目，活絡消腫。絡穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, brightens the eyes. Luo-connecting point.

records.location_zh: 小腿外側，外踝尖上 4 寸，腓骨前緣稍前方。
records.location_en: On the lateral lower leg, 4 cun proximal to the tip of the lateral malleolus, slightly anterior to the anterior border of the fibula.
functions_zh: 清熱散風，疏通經絡。經火穴。
functions_en: Clears heat, dispels wind, unblocks the channel. Jing-river and fire point.

records.location_zh: 踝區，外踝的前下方，趾長伸肌腱的外側凹陷中。
records.location_en: In the ankle region, anteroinferior to the lateral malleolus, in the depression lateral to the tendon of extensor digitorum longus.
functions_zh: 疏肝健脾，清熱化濕。原穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, clears damp-heat. Yuan-source point.

records.location_zh: 足背，第 4、5 蹠骨底結合部的前方，第 5 趾長伸肌腱外側凹陷中。
records.location_en: On the dorsum of the foot, anterior to the junction of the bases of the 4th and 5th metatarsals, in the depression lateral to the tendon of extensor digiti minimi.
functions_zh: 疏肝解鬱，熄風瀉火。輸木穴，八脈交會穴通帶脈。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, resolves depression, drains fire. Shu-stream point; confluent point of the Girdling Vessel.

records.location_zh: 足背，第 4、5 蹠骨間，第 4 蹠趾關節近端凹陷中，小趾伸肌腱內側緣。
records.location_en: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 4th and 5th metatarsals, proximal to the 4th metatarsophalangeal joint, medial to the tendon of extensor digiti minimi.
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, reduces swelling, unblocks the channel.

records.location_zh: 足背，第 4、5 趾之間，趾蹼緣後方赤白肉際處。
records.location_en: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 4th and 5th toes, proximal to the web margin at the border of the red and white skin.
functions_zh: 平肝熄風，消腫止痛。滎水穴。
functions_en: Calms the liver, extinguishes wind, reduces swelling. Ying-spring and water point.

records.location_zh: 第 4 趾末節外側，趾甲角旁開 0.1 寸。
records.location_en: On the lateral side of the distal phalanx of the 4th toe, 0.1 cun from the corner of the toenail.
functions_zh: 疏肝解鬱，聰耳明目。井金穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, benefits the ears and eyes. Jing-well and metal point.
records.needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或點刺出血。
